settings.title: Exchange only
settings.value: We exchange — no refunds under any circumstances. Swap for size, colour, or another style.

settings.title: Defective or wrong items
settings.value: Contact us within 48 hours of delivery. We cover return shipping and dispatch a replacement immediately.

settings.title: Original condition
settings.value: For size/style swaps: unused, unwashed, tags intact, original packaging. Customer pays return shipping.

settings.title: Reach out
settings.body: Email info@stitchfit.com.pk or WhatsApp +92 321 0900786 with your order number.

settings.title: Confirm
settings.body: We confirm eligibility and send return instructions tailored to your case.

settings.title: Ship back
settings.body: Send the item to: Climax Knitting Industry, S.I.E #1, Plot 94-B, Near Jinnah Road, Gujranwala, Punjab 52250.

settings.title: Exchange
settings.body: Your exchange is dispatched within 2–3 business days of receipt.

settings.hero_subhead: Stitch Fit operates an exchange-only policy. No refunds under any circumstances — but we'll happily swap your piece for a different size, colour, or style.
settings.yes_list:
• Defective or incorrectly shipped items (within 48 hours of delivery — we pay return shipping)
  • Unused items with original tags attached
  • Items in original, unopened packaging
  • Items that have not been washed, worn, or altered
settings.no_list:
• Washed, worn, or altered items
  • Items returned without original tags or packaging
  • Requests submitted more than 48 hours after delivery (for defective items)
  • Refund requests — we do not issue refunds under any circumstances
settings.cta_subhead: WhatsApp is fastest — usually replied to within a few hours. Email works too.
settings.whatsapp_message: Hi, I'd like to start an exchange for order #
settings.final_note: Received something faulty or wrong? Let us know within 48 hours — we'll cover return shipping and send the right piece out immediately.
